tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mnga' gsol 'dod dgu'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ hūm̐/ rang snang sku gsum rgyal ba'i dpal brnyes kyang / /gdul bya'i snang ngor dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /tha mal tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dpal mgon bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ /zhi chags khro bo'i rnam rol bsam yas kyis/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i re ba yongs skong ba/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan tshogs mnga' zhing / /mtshan tsam thos pas las sgrib kun sbyong ba/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /thugs ni zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /gdug cing gtum pa'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnam 'gyur khrag 'thung srin po'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /dam can chos skyong rnams la mnga' gsol lo/ /'og min gnas nas rgyal ba'i ye shes las/ /rgyal dang mi gnyis rgyal sras khro bo'i skur/ /yongs shar dpal ldan mahā kā la ni/ /byang chub bar du bdag gis skyabs su bsten/ /dbyings kyi dbang phyug yum chen lha mor bcas/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi spros mtshan kun zhi ba'i/ /chos nyid rtogs nas dmigs med snying rje yis/ /'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ /gang gi ye shes rol pa las byung ba/ /las mgon yab yum sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /sgrub po bdag gi nyams dang rtogs pa yi/ /ye shes snang ba 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' yi gnyer 'dzin pa/ /zhing skyong gdong bzhi dbang po 'khor bcas kyis/ /klu sgrub lugs bzang bden gnyis zung 'jug gnad/ /tshul bzhin rtogs nas bstan la phan par mdzod/ /sku yi mgon po stag zhon 'khor bcas kyis/ /rdo rje snying po bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/

/rnal 'byor bdag gis byang chub sgrub pa la/ /srung skyob sba ba'i phrin las g.yel med mdzod/ /dur khrod mkha' 'gro'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyis/ /zag bcas 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal kun sangs nas/ /zag med bde ba mchog gi ting 'dzin la/ /rgyun du rol pa'i dga' ston myong bar mdzod/ /ma rig nongs pa gang mchis bshags bgyid na/ /ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan 'khor bcas kyis/ /ma bzhin byams pa'i thugs kyis skyong ba dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog zhi bar mdzod/ /chos mthun yo byad 'byor pas phongs gyur na/ /mi zad nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /nor gyi dbang phyug rnam mang thos sras kyis/ /mkho dgus 'byor pa'i dga' ston bdag la stsol/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon li byin ha ra dang / /gnod sbyin chen po bka' blon dang bcas pas/ /mnyam nyid lta ba'i ngang las ma g.yos par/ /rig rtsal srung mar shes pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dngos 'dra bas/ /bsten cing bka' bsgo mdzad pa'i srung ma rnams/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang gus pas bsten lags na/ /nyin mtshan srung skyob mdzad par mnga' gsol lo/ /gnyis med ngang las nam yang mi g.yo zhing / /gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /snying rje'i dbang gis srung ma'i tshul 'dzin rnams/ /bstan dgra 'joms pa'i gshed por mnga' gsol lo/ /dus kyi dbang gis dam ldan nyung bas na/ /srung ma rgya mtsho'i thugs dang 'gal ba kun/ /nyams chag mthol bshags bzod par gsol ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /lhag bsam bzang pos khrims la mi gnas par/ /ljongs 'dir dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa la/ /gang la gang 'os chad pas 'dul ba sogs/ /dge bcu'i khrims kyi bdag por mnga' gsol lo/ /bdag dang bdag la ltos par bcas pa la/ /bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba'i mi srun pa'i/ /gdug rtsub chos kyi dbyings su sbyor nus pa'i/

/thugs rje mthu stobs ngom par mnga' gsol lo/ /bar chad byung na bsrungs zhing skyob pa dang / /phongs par gyur na 'dod dgu'i dpal ster zhing / /dgos 'dod gang yin myur du sgrub pa yi/ /yid brtan byams pa'i grogs su mnga' gsol lo/ /dben pa yid 'ong lha yi dga' tshal du/ /mar gyur 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje yis/ /rin chen byang chub sems la blo sbyong tshe/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes su mnga' gsol lo/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i man ngag ji bzhin du/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin sgom la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /drod rtags yon tan myur du skyed pa yi/ /gegs sel bogs 'don byed par mnga' gsol lo/ /bla ma mchog gsum rigs kyi bdag por bkur/ /dam chos rin chen snying gi nor du bzung / /bstan dang 'gro la lhag bsam 'bar ba'i tshe/ /lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par mnga' gsol lo/ /phyi yi 'khrul snang bden med sgyu mar mthong / /nang gi chos sku ye shes mig gis rig /phyi ma'i lam snang dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon byed por mnga' gsol lo/ /mchog gsum bla ma rang gi sems su shes/ /sems nyid rig stong ngang du mnyam bzhag nas/ /phrin las dbang phyug chos skyong srung ma rnams/ /rje btsun bla ma'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras rang ngo legs mthong nas/ /sku dang ye shes gsal snang mched pa'i tshe/ /mchog thun dngos grub tshul bzhin sbyin pa yi/ /yi dam rgya mtsho'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo/ /bla ma ltar du mnga' gsol byin gyis rlobs/ /yi dam ltar du mnga' gsol dngos grub stsol/ /chos skyong ltar du mnga' gsol phrin las sgrubs/ /yab gcig pha ltar mnga' gsol byams pas skyongs/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs char dus chu bo bzhin/ /dam ldan 'dus tshogs pad mtshor ngang mo bzhin/ /lung rtogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla shar bzhin/ /gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa yis/

/rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ /ces pa 'di ni mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i nyams len gyi gnad la blo'i snang ba cung zad thob cing / khyad par kye rdo rje'i rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i bla ma las nyan zhing thos bsam sgom gsum gyis zhugs pas rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon sum du rgyud la skyes pa tsam med kyang phyir ltas kyi rtog ge'i dpyod pa dang mi 'dra bar rang gis nyams myong gi tshul gyis mi 'phrog pa'i yid ches rnyed pa ri sul gyi ku sa li pa rgan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis dgos pa chen po yod par rloms nas bris pa'o// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sde ston a 'jam/ mnga' gsol 'dod dgu'i dpal ster/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
